simple.meaning: Chushim , the name of three Israelites

definitions.short: Chushim , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H2366. Chuwshiym I. חֻשִׁים חוּשִׁים, proper name, feminine wife of Shaharaim of Benjamin , חוּשִׁים 1Chr 8:8 , חֻשִׁים 8:11 . II. חֻשִׁים proper name, masculine of Dan , ח דּן ׳וּבְנֵי Gen 46:23 compare אַחֵר בְּנֵי חֻשִֿׁם 1Chr 7:12 (see Be VB); = שׁוּחָם (q. v.) Num 26:42 compare שׁוּחָתִי 26:42 ; 26:43 .
definitions.rootNote: or חֻשִׁים ; or חֻשִׁם ; plural from 2363 ; hasters;
